services.desc: Advanced Helicopter Pilot Training or specialized helicopter pilot training courses make you a safer, more capable pilot and a more competitive job candidate. HeliStream offers on-going helicopter pilot training in advanced courses to help prepare you for the job market, whether in California or another part of the world. Additional helicopter pilot training can increase your marketability in the competitive job market in California and throughout the US. For example, you may be competing with more experienced pilots who are less qualified when interviewing for jobs. services.name: Charter Rental
services.desc: HeliStream’s Orange County & San Diego helicopter charter rental service offers you and your clients a safe, exclusive, and time-saving form of transportation. Our helicopter charter services are approved under Part 135 of the Federal Aviation Regulations, with all pilots meeting the rigid requirements set forth by the FAA. From land surveys to airport shuttles, scenic tours to picnics in paradise, HeliStream is ready to serve you. HeliStream’s helicopter services are also available on contract.
